process: Wire spool install & wire-feed check (MIG/Flux-Core, general power-on sequence)
steps: Connect cables as needed for flux wire welding (see back of guide for process-specific cable setup).
Install wire spool. Insert wire through both feed guides and clamp it into feed mechanism. See manual if changing wire size or using solid wire.
Take off nozzle and tip, plug selected cord into welder and into wall, turn welder on, and press cold wire feed switch until wire comes out.
Incrementally tighten wire feed tension knob clockwise until wire will bend from feed tension at 2"-3".
Unplug welder and replace nozzle and tip.
Hold gun clear of workpiece, then plug in welder, turn it on, and set weld thickness and other settings.
Connect ground clamp to negative terminal.
Connect electrode holder to positive terminal.
Connect ground clamp to negative terminal.
Connect wire feed power to positive terminal.
Connect MIG gun to wire feed.
Connect wire feed control inside welder.
Follow MIG cable setup but connect ground clamp to positive terminal and wire feed power to negative terminal.
Connect ground clamp to positive terminal.
Connect TIG torch to negative terminal.
Connect gas line to gas regulator.
